an1.296:1.1: Ekadhammo bhikkhave bhāvito bahulīkato ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati. Katamo ekadhammo? Buddhānussati. Ayaṃ bhikkhave ekadhammo bhāvito . . . pe . . . saṃvattati.
